content.short: Small business banking app with envelopes, payments and cards.
content.description: NorthOne is a US business banking app built for small businesses, freelancers, and startups that want straightforward money management without traditional bank complexity. Through a partner bank it offers a business checking account, a debit card, and its signature 'Envelopes' feature that lets owners set aside money for taxes, payroll, and expenses automatically. NorthOne also supports ACH and wire payments, bill pay, mobile check deposit, and integrations with accounting and e-commerce tools, giving small business owners a clear view of cash flow. By focusing on budgeting-style envelopes and simple payments rather than sprawling product suites, NorthOne helps main-street businesses stay organized, plan ahead, and keep their finances under control from one mobile app.
content.meta: NorthOne is a US small-business banking app with envelopes, payments, and cards. Discover NorthOne and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
